'''KU-Kelar''' is a Quest Exclusive KU-Roro stationed at the [[Modulation Hall]] during the [[Chapter II]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|KU-Kelar}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''KU-Kelar:''' The currents of time are shifting once more...
:'''KU-Kelar:''' My records reveal that the Shorekeeper has always surfaced with the tides of change.
:{{DIcon}} Isn't this a sign of crisis?
:'''KU-Kelar:''' Indeed, crisis often heralds progress. A stagnant shore is merely a pool of dead water.
:'''KU-Kelar:''' The Black Shores will endure, as history has foretold."
----
:'''KU-Kelar:''' The result of the Third Contingency Protocol is...
:{{DIcon}} Hmm?
:'''KU-Kelar:''' The time reading is negative...
:'''KU-Kelar:''' Too distant... too distant... our reference frame is out of reach...
:'''KU-Kelar:''' Points, lines, and planes... beyond the light cone... constrained by the four fundamental rules...
:'''KU-Kelar:''' The multiplier is imaginary, compounding continuously... recall... our parameters...
:'''KU-Kelar:''' 6571756f206e652063726564697465……
:'''KU-Kelar:''' 506173742069732066757475726520616e64206675747572652069732070617374……
:{{DIcon}}  This robot seems to struggle with the concept...
:'''KU-Kelar:''' Ah, I understand now...
:'''KU-Kelar:''' I've been analyzing a theoretical problem.
:{{DIcon}} What problem?
:'''KU-Kelar:''' With enough data...
:'''KU-Kelar:''' Tethys might contain Lament data that we've never recorded but are certain has occurred, including the current Lament unfolding before us.
:'''KU-Kelar:''' Though the likelihood is small, it's theoretically possible with sufficient data.
:'''KU-Kelar:''' Imagine a drop of ink falling into the ocean, eventually reforming into the original drop...
:'''KU-Kelar:''' If that drop of ink, that Lament, does exist... maybe we just haven't detected it yet.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
*The first hex code translate to: "equo ne credite", which translate to "Don't trust the horse" in Latin.
**This possibly references the [[Imperator|Sentinel]] of [[Rinascita]], who appears in the form of a horse.
*The second hex code translates to "Past is Future and Future is Past"
